Last Sunday, Sam and Grace went to the school clinic. There are always many people at the health check. Grace's birthday is in May. Also, different people react to spicy food in different ways.
The weather was rainy that day. Both of them like soup and milk. Sam learned a lot about history. The liquid in the glass was clear and colourless.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the school clinic by bike. Sam borrowed a book about history from the gym. Sam hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Also, the casualty department sees burns first.
Sam thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. The school clinic is one of the best places in the city. Sam usually has soup for breakfast.
